notes.title: SuperJumpWorld Rage Level Editor Update
notes.content:
Did I said that I wouldn't add new content to the level editor? Well yes but actually I found out that I can add new objects to the level editor without older levels to not be updated with newer objects!!!

Here's a list of the new things that will come out so far:

[list]
[*] New Level Editor item: Arrow that is used to tell the player where to go or where something is
[*] New Level Editor item: Wood block, the one in level 8 and 9 that breaks from the middle
[*] New Level Editor item: Small group of knifes from the level 4, 8 and 9 that fall very fast
[*] New Level Editor item: Huge group of knifes from the level 5 and 7 that fall very slowly
[*] New Level Editor adjustement: When saving a loaded level, it's name will be pre-filled
[/list]

This list can change at any moment and idk when the update will come out so don't get too hype.

[*] New Level Editor item: Huge group of knifes from the level 5 and 7 that fall very slowly
[*] New Level Editor adjustement: When saving a loaded level, it's name will be pre-filled

notes.title: Level editor & bug fix update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43283105/5cd81dc4f92482880b68946fd8e0811e029bede1.png[/img]

Fix some bugs in the main game:
[list]
[*] Fix a bug when starting a new game right after quitting a loaded save
[*] Fix a bug that when downloading level, they wouldn't show up in the subscriptions menu
[*] Solo, multiplayer and red/blue color having some issues when selected and starting a new game
[*] Some others minor bugs
[/list]

Improved the level editor:
[list]
[*] Removed the limit of the rock and the knife, you can now place, more than one of them
[*] Remove the UI element of the limitation of some objects that had limitation
[*] If a button and/or 2 doors are placec on the level, their preview in the object selector is now hidden
[*] Being able to save a level while in "play" mode fixed
[*] "Finish a custom level" achievement can now only be unlocked when "play" is clickd in the menu
[/list]

Just to remind you that the knife and maybe the rock too can not function properly when a part of their
hitbox is out of the game's window.

If you encounter any bugs, thanks to tell me about it in the community hub.
